FAQs

Common Questions

What's included in the management fee?

Our management fee covers strategy, campaign setup, ad creation, copywriting, landing pages, optimization, and reporting. Ad spend is paid directly to Facebook and is not included in our fee.

How much should I budget for ad spend?

We recommend a minimum of $1,000/month in ad spend for testing and optimization. Most successful campaigns run $3,000-5,000/month in ad spend for optimal results.

How quickly will I see results?

Most clients see their first leads within 7-14 days of launch. It typically takes 30-45 days to fully optimize campaigns and achieve target cost per lead.

Do you guarantee results?

Yes! We offer a 90-day ROI guarantee. If you're not ROI positive within 90 days, we'll refund your management fees.
